item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dbra khyung pa snyigs ma'i kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la/ ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mo yis dpal lung dung mtsho phyug mo'i 'gram du bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud cing / slar lam dgon g.yung drung gtam brag tu me rta lor/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dbyings kyi bka' rgya bkrol nas/ dpal gyi gdan sa khyung nag pho brang du gtan la phab pa'o/ dpe gcig ni shog ser dmar po ring thung mtho gsum zhing sor lnga byas nas/ zhang zhung smar gyi yi ge phreng nyer gcig tu yod par/ brag seng ge gnam 'phyong gi sbar zhabs g.yon pa la sbas so/ 'di ni ma cig srid pa rgyal mo yi/ thugs kyi snying khrag ma zhes gnad kyi theg tsi ta dmar du phyung ba lta bu'o/ skal ldan dam tshig ldan la ma gsang spel/ gcig rgyud ma gtogs mang du ma spel cig ma mo mi 'bral lus kyi grib ltar 'grogs/ dam tshig nyams pa'i rigs la spel srid na/ ma cig rgyal mo'i bka' chad myur du 'ongs/ dam nyams dad pa med pa'i ru tra can/ bstan dgra nyams pa'i bka' la brku srid cing / bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i dgra ru yong srid na/ srid pa rgyal mos bka' chad myur du thongs/ dmar 'byin chen po 'di yi snying khrag 'thung*/ thugs sprul gnyen mos de yi srog rtsa chod/ gze gyad spar mas de yi tsi ta phyungs/ (?)dbal mos de ni ma nor ba/ srog khrag dron mo khyed kyi zhal du rngubs/ u ya// sa trig srugs//
